title: STEMMA canonical entity
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of one canonical knowledge entity (v1.0). IDs live in the stemma: namespace (ADR-0027).

id.description: Stable identifier, namespace stemma:<domain>.<slug>. Never reused.

type.description: Entity type. v0.3 (ADR-0021): adds phenomenon, model, experiment — types the relation registry already referenced in domain/range (audit F3/R20). Additive; type changes on existing entities remain forbidden.

definition.description: Scientific definition exactly as meter example with reference — claim with warrant definitional + evidence per L1, not mere orientation, must show agreed status and source reference per ADR-0044

equation.description: Canonical mathematical form using defined symbols (optional)

symbol.description: Symbol(s) for the quantity or law (optional)

key_experiments.description: Classic experiments or demonstrations that establish this concept.

subdomain.description: Subdomain within domain, e.g. mechanics, per vocabularies/subdomains.yaml (ADR-0034). Optional but required for physics-core v2.

source_refs.description: Canonical source records that support this entity definition — dual verification with embedded provenance (ADR-0043). At least 1 required for physics-core.

governed_by.description: Governing laws that govern this entity — deterministic placement without LLM reasoning. Every physics entity must have at least one (see PHYSICS-GOVERNING-LAWS.md and physics-governing-registry.yaml). At least 1 required for physics-core v2.

writer.description: Agent id who wrote this entity file, e.g. human:curator.001 — for audit trail and double verification (ADR-0043).

drafted_by.description: Machine agent (llm:* or process:*) that produced the original draft, when a human is the writer. Origin is preserved, never rewritten (CURATION-PROTOCOL §6, H1). Must resolve in schema/agent-registry.yaml.

original_author.description: Who originally stated the science (distinct from writer) — e.g., Halliday et al (ADR-0043).

link.description: URL or DOI to source for triple-check verification (ADR-0043).

retrieved_at.description: ISO date when source link was accessed (ADR-0043).

extensions.description: Adaptive metadata seam (ADR-0017). Open at schema level so new knowledge-layer dimensions never hard-fail; the validator enforces that every key is registered in schema/extension-registry.yaml for this object kind.

version.description: ADR-0016 (implemented by ADR-0021): optional monotonically increasing object revision. Identity never encodes version (ADR-0003); content integrity is the derived content_hash.

updated_at.description: ADR-0016: optional ISO8601 last-modification timestamp of this entity object.

propertyNames.description: Namespaced external identifier scheme, e.g. wd (Wikidata QID), orcid, doi, isbn, qudt, ucum, cas.

external_ids.description: ADR-0016 (implemented by ADR-0021): namespaced external anchor identifiers, e.g. external_ids: {wd: Q11402, qudt: unit-MeterPerSecondSquared}. Multi-valued per scheme. STEMMA stays independently authoritative — external IDs link and anchor, never import content.

rights.description: ADR-0016: optional per-object rights statement. Defaults to the repository-level CC BY 4.0 content license when absent.

stated_by.description: Person/group who first stated or discovered the claim (required when field present)

year.description: Year (CE; negative for BCE) of first statement/publication

where.description: Optional: the work/source where it was stated

note.description: Optional attribution caveat / uncertainty / contested-origin note

historical.description: Historical scientific attribution (ADR-0018): who first stated this claim and when. Distinct from provenance (record source).

quantity_kind.description: SI classification of a quantity entity: base (of the seven SI base quantities) or derived (combination of base quantities). REQUIRED when type=quantity (owner directive 2026-09-22).

tensor_character.description: Tensorial character of a quantity entity: scalar/vector/tensor. REQUIRED when type=quantity (owner directive 2026-09-22).

same_dimensional_quantities.description: Quantity names sharing this entity's SI dimension class (for unit entities: quantities expressible in this unit). REQUIRED non-empty when type=quantity|unit; explicit null for types where the notion does not apply (law etc.). Owner directive 2026-09-22.
